title: Miracle Cure: Essential Oils Can Replace All Medications

claims.text: Essential oils can cure cancer and other chronic diseases.
claims.explanation: No scientific evidence supports essential oils as a cure for cancer. The FDA has not approved any essential oil as a cancer treatment.

claims.text: Essential oils are completely safe and have no side effects.
claims.explanation: False. Essential oils can cause allergic reactions, skin irritation, and interact with medications.

claims.text: Some essential oils have antimicrobial properties.
claims.explanation: True. Some essential oils like tea tree oil have shown antimicrobial properties in laboratory studies.

claims.text: The pharmaceutical industry suppresses natural remedies.
claims.explanation: Conspiracy theory with no evidence. Many natural remedies have been studied and approved by regulatory agencies.

trust_score_description: Very Low - Only 1 out of 4 claims has scientific backing
